name: security-cn-pack
description: Chinese security hunting pack: SRC/bug-bounty workflow (19 playbooks, 305 payloads, 263 WAF-bypass variants), HW (HV) red/blue team drills, CNVD/CNNVD submission playbooks, and an 11-vulnerability-class methodology reference.

description_i18n.en: Chinese security hunting pack: SRC/bug-bounty workflow (19 playbooks, 305 payloads, 263 WAF-bypass variants), HW (HV) red/blue team drills, CNVD/CNNVD submission playbooks, and an 11-vulnerability-class methodology reference.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 中文安全挖洞技能包四合一：SRC/众测实战工作流（19 个攻击 playbook + 305 结构化 payload + 263 个 WAF 绕过变体）、护网攻防双视角（红队手法链 + 蓝队检测三角与国产安全产品线）、CNVD/CNNVD 证书报送全流程（案例凑数/定级公式/合规红线）、11 类漏洞方法论手册（IDOR/SSRF/JWT/竞态/原型污染等测试与绕过）。触发词：src 挖洞、护网、CNVD 报送、怎么挖某类漏洞。
